author: Nerdstalgic
description:
The Scrubs reboot had every reason to fail. But somehow....it worked.

More than 15 years after JD left Sacred Heart, Scrubs returned with a difficult balancing act: bring back the characters fans loved without turning the revival into a nostalgia cash grab.

After the infamous Med School season, expectations weren't exactly high, but the Scrubs reboot found a way to embrace what made the original series special while embracing a new team of doctors.

From the decision to retcon Med School and return Sacred Heart to its former glory, this reboot knows what made Scrubs so beloved in the first place.

Because this isn't just Scrubs remembering the good old days.  It's Scrubs figuring out how to grow up.

title: How Scrubs Brought Sacred Heart Back to Life
